goals: G1 Clear the pre-existing bun run typecheck backlog (P0, primary): 17 real TypeScript errors confirmed unchanged (Base UI Select nullability x6, react-resizable-panels API drift x4, recharts type-export drift x1, 6 other not-previously-itemized errors), PLUS a newly-discovered structural finding: 6 of 7 root package.json scripts (build/dev/test/test:e2e/lint/typecheck/format) that use `pnpm --filter ./frontend <cmd>` are non-functional from repo root because root was never registered as a pnpm workspace member of frontend during the already-landed frontend-pnpm-workspace-migration change -- confirmed working alternative is `pnpm -C frontend <cmd>` (matches build.rs's own already-working pattern); confirmed REJECTED alternative is adding root-level `packages: - frontend`, which breaks frontend's own nested workspace (the entity-mgmt submodule).
changes_completed_note: Assessed 2026-07-06 (assessment.md). Resolved the pnpm build-approval gate (allowBuilds: @parcel/watcher: true in root pnpm-workspace.yaml, a legitimate well-known native package). Found and confirmed via direct testing that this alone wasn't enough -- root-level `bun run typecheck`/build/dev/test/lint/format all fail with 'No projects matched the filters' because repo root isn't a registered pnpm workspace member of frontend (frontend has its own nested pnpm-workspace.yaml for the entity-mgmt submodule, and nesting workspace roots this way isn't supported cleanly). Confirmed `pnpm -C frontend <cmd>` as a working fix candidate (matches build.rs's already-working current_dir-based invocation) and confirmed adding root-level `packages: - frontend` as a REJECTED alternative (breaks the submodule resolution). Reconfirmed the 17 real TypeScript errors are unchanged from prior phases when run correctly (`pnpm typecheck` inside frontend/ or `pnpm -C frontend typecheck`) -- itemized all 17 by file/cause, including 6 not previously broken out individually. Next: /kbd-plan to sequence (1) the small, low-risk root-script invocation fix, then (2) the 17 TypeScript fixes, likely grouped by cause (Base UI Select, resizable-panels, recharts, misc).
